intro.text: A Terrisman steward and Keeper working with Kelsier's band of thieves, considered something of a rebel by other Keepers.
A Terris Keeper traveling the land after the Lord Ruler's death to teach people the knowledge and religions of the past.
A Terris Keeper serving as Chief Ambassador of Elend Venture's New Empire, struggling to recover his lost faith.
The former Keeper who took up the powers of both Ruin and Preservation, remaking the world as Harmony.

items.text: The only Terrisman actively helping the skaa rebellion, Sazed gathered information and carried messages. He often discussed religion and philosophy with Kelsier. Fascinated by the logbook's descriptions of the Terris people and a green land, he and Vin also tested whether she could burn his metalminds, a clue to the Lord Ruler's immortality.

As Kelsier's steward, Sazed served Lord Renoux and prepared Vin to pose as a noblewoman, drilling her in noble families, dinners, etiquette, gossip and dancing. He went with her to balls, first staying close to advise her and then joining the stewards' dinner to gather intelligence, reporting everything he noticed afterward.

Finding Vin missing after she followed Kelsier to Kredik Shaw, Sazed went after her and pulled her out just in time, badly wounded, along with a book they found there. Believing it the Lord Ruler's own logbook, he spent long, unusually excited hours translating it.
After Kelsier's death, Sazed kept believing in him, chose to record his stories, and suggested his death might have been part of his plan.

Sazed's words spurred Vin to return to the palace, and he followed her. When she was captured, he let himself be beaten and jailed beside her, then used his metalminds to break open the cells. When Elend's men arrived, Sazed took Elend to safety so Vin could face the Lord Ruler.
Returning for Vin, Sazed found she had beaten the Lord Ruler but not yet killed him. They heard him warn that killing him doomed them, and Vin finished him with a spear.
Sazed worked out that the Lord Ruler had been both Feruchemist and Allomancer, explaining his youth and power, the Terris breeding program, and his hatred of the Keepers.

title.text: Travels and the siege of Luthadel

items.text: Sazed left Luthadel to fulfill his Keeper's duty, heading south. He found the land in chaos and the people uninterested in new religions, so he taught practical skills instead, growing doubtful of the rebellion's results as he came across strange deaths linked to the mists.

Marsh, now an Inquisitor and noticeably changed, led Sazed to the Conventical of Seran, where Inquisitors had slaughtered the servants. Sazed found spikes and a metal plate bearing Kwaan's last words, confessing he had betrayed Alendi. He made a charcoal rubbing and headed north to share it.

On the way, Sazed found a village starved inside their homes for fear of daytime mists, and helped a survivor before hurrying on. He then talked his way out of Jastes Lekal's camp of over twenty thousand koloss, carrying Jastes's demand for atium to Elend.
Sazed reached Luthadel to find Straff's and Cett's armies already besieging it, with the koloss on the way. His warnings about the mists were not fully believed.

Sazed studied Kwaan's words alongside Alendi's logbook and helped Elend find lawful ways to keep his throne while caring for the city's poor and sick. Working with Tindwyl, who had disapproved of his defiance of the Synod, he found inconsistencies in Kwaan's story, and the two fell in love.
Sure Luthadel would fall, Sazed gathered the crew and they agreed to trick Elend, Vin and Spook into leaving the city. He married Vin and Elend just before the battle.

Defending the Steel Gate, Sazed lost his nerve and asked to leave the command chain, but when skaa hailing him as Holy First Witness gathered, he fought a koloss with Feruchemy and led them. His gate fell last. After Vin saved the city, he concluded she was the Hero of Ages.

Tindwyl died in the battle, and grief drove Sazed to despair and doubt his religions. Investigating the Well, he was attacked by Marsh; Marsh's mistaken gift of metalmind rings let him fight back until Ham rescued him, and Marsh was left with a spike driven deeper.
Sazed returned to the Conventical and realized the words he had read had been altered, concluding only words in metal could be trusted. The last of his faith left him.

As Chief Ambassador of the New Empire, Sazed successfully negotiated a treaty with King Lekal. A year after losing Tindwyl he had stopped wearing his copperminds and was studying religions one by one, rejecting each over any contradiction. Vin was among the few who worried about him.

Reluctantly given command of the mission to Urteau, Sazed first visited the Terris people at the Pits of Hathsin, who honored him as a lord. He saw the mists did not harm them, made sure key knowledge was kept in metal, and declined their request that he lead them.

In Urteau, Sazed and Breeze were rebuffed by Quellion, the Citizen, but found Spook, who hid them in the Canton of Inquisition. After helping rescue Spook from an execution, Sazed, depressed, chose to follow him, reverse-engineering the machinery to reflood the canals while growing to respect him.
Spook took over leadership in Urteau and sought Sazed's support in religion; Sazed suspected Spook was gaining new powers, and found himself inspired by him.
As riots burned Urteau, no one was left to flood the canals. Sazed gave up at the burning building, but Spook pushed through the flames and triggered the mechanism, saving the city.

Finishing his last religion without answers, Sazed despaired until TenSoon, calling him the Announcer, helped him see the first kandra were Rashek's Terris companions. In the kandra Homeland, the First Generation told him of Ruin and Preservation, and he learned the atium was Ruin's body.

KanPaar seized control of the kandra and imprisoned Sazed. Freed by TenSoon and MeLaan, Sazed survived TenSoon being forced by Ruin to attack him, and the First Generation became mistwraiths in the Resolution. Sazed regained his faith, believing Vin the Hero. He then brought Elend the kandra's atium for the final fight.

Finding Vin dead after she killed Ruin, Sazed realized he himself was the Hero of Ages. He took up both Ruin and Preservation and, drawing on all his knowledge, remade the world much as it had been, becoming Harmony.
Kelsier, watching from the Cognitive Realm, was with Sazed when he took up the power, and the two were united afterward.
Sazed left Vin's and Elend's restored but lifeless bodies for Spook to find, with a book explaining what had happened.
As Harmony, Sazed interprets his purpose as allowing people to make their own choices, believing even the capacity for evil is necessary for free will to exist.
Harmony worried he had made life too easy for humanity, slowing its progress by removing the need to strive.
Over time, Harmony became less attached to his masculinity and more accepting of gender-neutral terms; some people imagine him as both male and female.

Paalm and Wax both called Harmony a hypocrite for preaching free will while manipulating people. Harmony promised Wax that stopping the bombing of Elendel and the arrival of Autonomy would be his last request.

Harmony groomed Wax as his Sword, sending the kandra Paalm and pushing him through painful acts for Scadrial's future. He respected Wax's hatred and tried other ways to stop Trell before begging for his help, finally apologizing for making Wax feel his life was not his own.
Respecting Wax's wish never to hear his voice again, Harmony spoke to him through Marsh, his loyal agent across Scadrial, and still loved Wax despite his anger.

appearance.text: Sazed is tall and long-limbed with a scholar's build, his limbs slightly long from being castrated as a boy. He has a shaved head, stretched earlobes ringed with studs, and wears a Terris steward's colorful V-patterned robes. He speaks softly with a melodic accent.

personality.text: Sazed believes true faith grows stronger in hard times and that change cannot be stopped, so moments must be enjoyed, yet he devotes his life to preserving lost cultures and religions.

Kind, peaceful and respectful but quick-tongued, Sazed is a secretive Keeper wearing many metalminds. A Feruchemist, his copperminds hold vast knowledge, above all of five hundred and sixty-two religions.
Sazed loves research, keeps an orderly workspace, and speaks in a careful Terris way, softening statements, using long compound sentences and hedging questions.
As Harmony, Sazed dislikes being worshipped, saying doing good is worship enough, and still holds that every faith holds some truth, urging people to study the religions in the Words of Founding.
